approvalEvidence: Пользователь отобрал 20 картинок («Добавь все имеющиеся картинки, получается 20 штук, включая вот эти с плавным переходом», Art/Source/Environment/field-002-ruins-obstacles/library.json) и поручил интегрировать их на тестовое поле: «Возьми, соответственно, их 20 штук и интегрируй» (2026-10-01).
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached existing game obstacle sprite. Create a soft natural ground transition for placement on a warm muted beige map floor. Preserve EXACT original canvas, core position, core shape, orientation, camera, interior objects and their pixel scale. Change ONLY the perimeter: completely remove the continuous dark purple polygon outline. Replace the abrupt straight cut edge of the soil with an irregular broken brush-painted transition, transitioning through sparse debris and decreasing opacity into true transparency within approximately 40–70 source pixels. Keep a readable dense obstacle core. Allow a narrow visual skirt outside the old footprint, preserve generous transparent canvas padding. Ground net: let the earth end in sparse tufts, dusty brush marks and a few loose small stones. Preserve the right-side inward notch, all ropes, rope thickness, cloth strips and anchors. Stylized hand-painted storybook game art, muted colours. No continuous ring or rim, no broad fog halo, no added platform height, no background, no text, no checkerboard. True alpha transparency including semi-transparent transition pixels.
constraints: fixed authored orientation and footprint size; no random rotation or scale
soft-edge variant keeps its core footprint scale
